question:
**Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.**

restore
solution:
The correct answer is "**damage**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given word.
 
• **restore**: return (someone or something) to a former condition, place, or position.
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given options.
 
 
• **remove: **take (something) away or off from the position occupied.
 
• **damage: **physical harm that impairs the value, usefulness, or normal function of something.
 
• **claim: **state or assert that something is the case, typically without providing evidence or proof.
 
• **repeat: **say again something one has already said.
 
 
 
• As per the meaning of the given words, "**damage**" is the antonym of restore.
 
 
• **Example**: T*he **damage **__to the optic nerve resulted in partial blindness for the patient.*
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is **option 2.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] __Hinglish__** 

 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given word.
 
• **restore**: किसी पूर्व स्थिति, स्थान या स्थिति में वापस (किसी या कुछ)।
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given options.
 
 
• **remove:**** **कब्जा किए गए स्थान से (कुछ) दूर या दूर ले जाना।
 
• **damage:**** **शारीरिक नुकसान जो किसी चीज के मूल्य, उपयोगिता या सामान्य कार्य को बाधित करता है।
 
• **claim:**** ​**राज्य या दावा करें कि कुछ मामला है, आमतौर पर सबूत या सबूत प्रदान किए बिना।
 
• **repeat:**** **फिर से कुछ कहो जो पहले ही कह चुका है।
 
 
 
• As per the meaning of the given words, "**damage**" is the antonym of restore.
